AVIATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #17
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: AVIATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Remove all guards
   B. Run with the tool
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

2. When learning Terminal Operations, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Terminal Operations.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Terminal Operations.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Terminal Operations.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Terminal Operations.

3. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Internal Cooking Timer
   B. Information and Communication Technology
   C. International Cricket Team
   D. Input Cable Tester

4. When learning Airfield Safety, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Airfield Safety.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Airfield Safety.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Airfield Safety.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Airfield Safety.

5. When learning Flight Instruments, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Flight Instruments.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Flight Instruments.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Flight Instruments.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Flight Instruments.

6. When learning Aircraft Structures, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Structures.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Structures.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Structures.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Structures.

7. When learning Flight Controls, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Flight Controls.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Flight Controls.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Flight Controls.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Flight Controls.

8. When learning Aircraft Propulsion, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Propulsion.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Propulsion.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Propulsion.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Propulsion.

9. When learning Ramp services, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Ramp services.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Ramp services.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Ramp services.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Ramp services.

10. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Speaker
   B. Monitor
   C. Keyboard
   D. CPU

11. When learning Navigation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Navigation.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Navigation.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Navigation.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Navigation.

12. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Overload every socket
   C. Ignore burnt cables
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Aircraft Propulsion and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Flight Controls and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Flight Instruments and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

====

2. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Terminal Operations.

3. B — Information and Communication Technology

4. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Airfield Safety.

5. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Flight Instruments.

6. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Structures.

7. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Flight Controls.

8. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Propulsion.

9. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Ramp services.

10. D — CPU

11. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Navigation.

12. D — Never touch live wires with wet hands

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Aircraft Propulsion; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
